evidence.quote: T6 heat treatment was carried out for all the as-cast alloys, including solution, quenching, and ageing.
The dark grey α-Al with dendritic structure is the matrix phase (Fig. 3a).
Some α-Al + Al2Cu eutectic groups are distributed inside the α-Al matrix (Fig. 3a, e).
The eutectic structure of α-Al + Al3Ni2 is distributed at the grain boundary or between the dendrites of α-Al primary grains (Fig. 3b).
A small amount of dark grey massive Al3Ni phase was symbiosis with the Al3Ni2 phase (Fig. 3e).
A small amount of blocky Al7Cu4Ni phase (bright white) is distributed along the edge of the fishbone like Al3Ni2 (Fig. 3b, c).
When the addition of V increased to 0.45 wt.%, the coarse blocky Al10V phase was precipitated from the matrix, as shown in Fig. 3d, e.
As seen in Fig. 3, the size of the α-Al grain or dendrite decreases gradually with the increase in V addition, indicating that V can refine the α-Al grain or dendrite.
